input.content:
# Mezo buildathon — competitor watch

## New this week
- **Satoshi Pay** (payments): merchant checkout on Mezo.
- **Vault Kit** (savings): automated BTC savings vaults.
- **Bridge Bot** (agents): an agent that moves funds between chains on request.

## Overlap with us
Bridge Bot is the closest to our agent idea. Our edge: approvals before any action and a learning loop.

## Next
Re-check Thursday; look at Bridge Bot's demo video.
